summary: Fail Fractal web production builds that emit a stylesheet without rules, or a chunk that loads a font file no @font-face in its loaded stylesheets declares, and prove both failures in a CI lane before the app build.

replay.detail: No store replay or startup path change; the guard runs only inside the Vite production build.

schema.detail: No database schema, index, trigger, or version change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule or digest change.

compatibility.detail: No client, peer, wire, or runtime contract change. Emitted web assets are unchanged; builds that would ship an empty stylesheet or an undeclared font now fail instead.

downtime.detail: No daemon or deployment path change.
